646: function parseF2(root: Record<string, unknown>): F2Section {
647:   const key = 'f2Seasonality'
648:   const section = asRecord(root[key], `findings.${key}`)
649:   const numbers = numbersOf(section, key)
650:   const chartTwin = chartTwinOf(section, key)
651:   const strongest = asString(numbers.strongestCalendarCategory, `${key}.numbers.strongestCalendarCategory`)
652:   const monthLabels = stringList(chartTwin.monthLabels, `${key}.chartTwin.monthLabels`)
653:   const monthShares = recordList(chartTwin.monthShares, `${key}.chartTwin.monthShares`).map(
654:     (entry, index) => ({
655:       name: asString(entry.name, `${key}.chartTwin.monthShares[${index}].name`),
656:       shares: numberList(entry.shares, `${key}.chartTwin.monthShares[${index}].shares`),
657:     }),
658:   )
659:   const strongestSeries = monthShares.find((entry) => entry.name === strongest)
660:   if (!strongestSeries) {
661:     throw new Error(`${key}.chartTwin.monthShares must carry the strongest calendar category`)
662:   }
663:   if (strongestSeries.shares.length !== monthLabels.length) {
664:     throw new Error(`${key}.chartTwin.monthShares must match chartTwin.monthLabels in length`)
665:   }
666:   const categories = recordList(section.categories, `${key}.categories`)
667:   const strongestCategory = categories.find((entry) => entry.name === strongest)
668:   if (!strongestCategory) {
669:     throw new Error(`${key}.categories must carry the strongest calendar category`)
670:   }
671:   const calendarMonthShares = numberList(
672:     strongestCategory.monthDayShares,
673:     `${key}.categories[].monthDayShares`,
674:   )
675:   if (calendarMonthShares.length !== monthLabels.length) {
676:     throw new Error(`${key}.categories[].monthDayShares must match chartTwin.monthLabels in length`)
677:   }
678:   const holidayWindow = asRecord(strongestCategory.holidayWindow, `${key}.categories[].holidayWindow`)
679:   return {
680:     id: 'F2',
681:     key,
682:     question: questionOf(section, key),
683:     method: methodOf(section, key),
684:     methodOneLiner: firstSentence(methodOf(section, key)),
685:     limitations: limitationsOf(section, key),
686:     headline: headlineFor('F2', root),
687:     metric: metricF2(section, key),
688:     overallVerdict: asString(numbers.overallVerdict, `${key}.numbers.overallVerdict`),
689:     verdictSummary: asString(numbers.verdictSummary, `${key}.numbers.verdictSummary`),
690:     strongestCalendarCategory: strongest,
691:     strongestCalendarLift: asNumber(numbers.strongestCalendarLift, `${key}.numbers.strongestCalendarLift`),
692:     strongestBehavioralCategory: asString(
693:       numbers.strongestBehavioralCategory,
694:       `${key}.numbers.strongestBehavioralCategory`,
695:     ),
696:     strongestBehavioralDeviation: asNumber(
697:       numbers.strongestBehavioralDeviation,
698:       `${key}.numbers.strongestBehavioralDeviation`,
699:     ),
700:     holidayWindowDays: asInteger(numbers.holidayWindowDays, `${key}.numbers.holidayWindowDays`),
701:     holidayWindowStart: asString(holidayWindow.start, `${key}.categories[].holidayWindow.start`),
702:     holidayWindowEnd: asString(holidayWindow.end, `${key}.categories[].holidayWindow.end`),
703:     holidayLiftThreshold: asNumber(numbers.holidayLiftThreshold, `${key}.numbers.holidayLiftThreshold`),
704:     weeklyDeviationThreshold: asNumber(
705:       numbers.weeklyDeviationThreshold,
706:       `${key}.numbers.weeklyDeviationThreshold`,
707:     ),
708:     minimumWeeklyRows: asInteger(numbers.minimumWeeklyRows, `${key}.numbers.minimumWeeklyRows`),
709:     monthLabels,
710:     monthShares,
711:     calendarMonthShares,
712:     strongestHolidayShare: asNumber(holidayWindow.share, `${key}.categories[].holidayWindow.share`),
713:     categoryVerdicts: categories.map((entry, index) => ({
714:       name: asString(entry.name, `${key}.categories[${index}].name`),
715:       verdict: asString(entry.verdict, `${key}.categories[${index}].verdict`),
716:     })),
717:   }
718: }

720: function parseF3(root: Record<string, unknown>): F3Section {

722:   const section = asRecord(root[key], `findings.${key}`)
723:   const numbers = numbersOf(section, key)
724:   const chartTwin = chartTwinOf(section, key)
725:   const roc = asRecord(chartTwin.roc, `${key}.chartTwin.roc`)
726:   const confusion = asRecord(numbers.confusion, `${key}.numbers.confusion`)
727:   const chartCoefficients = recordList(chartTwin.coefficients, `${key}.chartTwin.coefficients`)
728:   const coefficients = recordList(section.coefficients, `${key}.coefficients`).map(
729:     (entry, index) => ({
730:       feature: asString(entry.feature, `${key}.coefficients[${index}].feature`),
731:       coefficient: asNumber(
732:         entry.standardizedCoefficient,

734:       ),
735:       direction: asString(entry.direction, `${key}.coefficients[${index}].direction`),

737:   )
738:   const byFeature = new Map(coefficients.map((entry) => [entry.feature, entry.coefficient]))
739:   const chartCoefficientFeatures = chartCoefficients.map((entry, index) => {
740:     const feature = asString(entry.feature, `${key}.chartTwin.coefficients[${index}].feature`)
741:     if (!byFeature.has(feature)) {

745:   })

780:     randomSeed: asInteger(numbers.randomSeed, `${key}.numbers.randomSeed`),

782:     rocFpr: numberList(roc.fpr, `${key}.chartTwin.roc.fpr`),

988: /**
989:  * Validate a parsed findings.json payload as the full report: meta facts,
990:  * then F1 to F5 with every field the report UI draws (question, method,
991:  * numbers, chart twin slices, limitations).
992:  */
993: export function parseFindingsReport(raw: unknown): FindingsReport {
994:   const root = asRecord(raw, 'findings')
995:   const meta = parseReportMeta(root)
996:   const sections: ReportSection[] = [
997:     parseF1(root),
998:     parseF2(root),
999:     parseF3(root),
1000:     parseF4(root),
1001:     parseF5(root),
1002:   ]
1003:   return { meta, sections }
1004: }

1006: /** Fetch and validate the bundled full report (offline booth friendly). */
1007: export async function loadFindingsReport(): Promise<FindingsReport> {

1010:     throw new Error(`findings.json fetch failed with status ${response.status}`)
1011:   }
1012:   return parseFindingsReport(await response.json())
1013: }

1: """Pure judge metrics over integer cent row sequences.
2: 
3: Every function in this module is pure: no pandas, no numpy, no file IO.
4: All money values are integer CAD cents and rounding happens once at the
5: metric boundary with ROUND_HALF_UP (ties away from zero).
6: 
7: Judge definitions from docs/tangerine-challenge.md:
8: 
9: * I = median of money_in over all monthly rows
10: * F = median over months of the per month row sum household_bills +
11:   insurance + loan_payments (per row sums first, never a sum of medians)
12: * S = median of money_out over all monthly rows
13: * B = mean of avg_daily_balance over the last min(6, n) rows sorted by
14:   month, rounded half up; fewer than 6 rows uses every available row
15: * H = median of household_bills over all monthly rows
16: * P = monthly_payment from loans.csv when status is C or D (running at
17:   the end of 2025), otherwise 0; P comes from the loan record in build.py
18: * gap = S minus I
19: 
20: Run from the repository root:
21: 
22:     uv run python -m scripts.engine.build
23: """

25: from __future__ import annotations

27: from dataclasses import dataclass
28: from typing import Sequence

30: # Rule versions recorded in the artifact meta.
31: METRIC_RULE_VERSION: str = "judge-metrics-v1"
32: 
33: # The buffer window is the last 6 rows by month (the judge rule for B).
34: BUFFER_WINDOW_ROWS: int = 6
35: 
36: # The thin_history flag threshold: fewer than 18 monthly rows, a quarter
37: # of the 72 month dataset span (2020-01 to 2025-12). Every real account
38: # has at least 12 rows, so a 6 row threshold would never fire; 18 fires
39: # on the genuinely short histories (rationale recorded in the Phase E1
40: # decision record, docs/decisions.md). The flag is separate from
41: # BUFFER_WINDOW_ROWS, which only decides how many rows B averages.
42: THIN_HISTORY_ROWS: int = 18
43: 
44: # The single swappable rule deciding which loan statuses count as running
45: # at the end of 2025 (user confirmed decision, docs/decisions.md E1).
46: RUNNING_STATUS_RULE: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"C", "D"})
47: DEFAULTED_STATUS: str = "D"
48: END_OF_2025_MONTH: str = "2025-12"
49: 
50:

52: class RowCents:
53:     """One monthly_summary row with every money value in integer cents."""
54: 
55:     month: str
56:     money_in: int
57:     money_out: int
58:     household_bills: int
59:     insurance: int
60:     loan_payments: int
61:     pension_in: int
62:     avg_daily_balance: int

66: class Metrics:
67:     """The six judge numbers plus the F decomposition and the gap."""
68: 
69:     income_cents: int
70:     fixed_costs_cents: int
71:     spending_cents: int
72:     buffer_cents: int

80: def round_half_up(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> int:
81:     """Divide with ROUND_HALF_UP: ties away from zero (decimal semantics).
82: 
83:     The positive case is (numerator + denominator // 2) // denominator;
84:     the sign split makes negative operands round away from zero on ties
85:     as well, which matches Python's decimal ROUND_HALF_UP.
86:     """
87:     if denominator <= 0:
88:         raise ValueError(f"denominator must be positive, got {denominator}")
89:     sign = 1 if numerator >= 0 else -1
90:     magnitude = (abs(numerator) + denominator // 2) // denominator
91:     return sign * magnitude
92: 
93: 
94: def median_cents(values: Sequence[int]) -> int:
95:     """Median of integer cents: middle value, or half up mean of two middles."""
96:     if not values:
97:         raise ValueError("median_cents requires at least one value")
98:     ordered = sorted(values)
99:     middle = len(ordered) // 2
100:     if len(ordered) % 2 == 1:
101:         return ordered[middle]
102:     return round_half_up(ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle], 2)
103: 
104: 
105: def mean_cents(values: Sequence[int]) -> int:
106:     """Mean of integer cents rounded half up (ties away from zero)."""
107:     if not values:
108:         raise ValueError("mean_cents requires at least one value")
109:     return round_half_up(sum(values), len(values))
110: 
111: 
112: def profile_metrics(rows: Sequence[RowCents]) -> Metrics:
113:     """Compute I, F, S, B, H plus the F decomposition for one account.
114: 
115:     rows are the account's monthly rows; they are re sorted by month
116:     ascending inside so the last 6 row buffer window is exact no matter
117:     what order the caller passes.
118:     """
119:     if not rows:
120:         raise ValueError("profile_metrics requires at least one row")
121:     ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row.month)
122: 
123:     income = median_cents([row.money_in for row in ordered])
124:     spending = median_cents([row.money_out for row in ordered])
125:     fixed = median_cents(
126:         [
127:             row.household_bills + row.insurance + row.loan_payments
128:             for row in ordered
129:         ]
130:     )
131:     household = median_cents([row.household_bills for row in ordered])
132:     insurance = median_cents([row.insurance for row in ordered])
133:     loan_payments = median_cents([row.loan_payments for row in ordered])
134:     pension_total = sum(row.pension_in for row in ordered)
135:     window = ordered[-min(BUFFER_WINDOW_ROWS, len(ordered)):]
136:     buffer_cents = mean_cents([row.avg_daily_balance for row in window])
137:     gap = spending - income
138: 
139:     return Metrics(
140:         income_cents=income,
141:         fixed_costs_cents=fixed,
142:         spending_cents=spending,
143:         buffer_cents=buffer_cents,
144:         household_bills_cents=household,
145:         insurance_cents=insurance,
146:         loan_payments_median_cents=loan_payments,
147:         pension_in_cents=pension_total,
148:         gap_cents=gap,
149:     )
150: 
151: 
152: def derive_flags(
153:     metric: Metrics, row_count: int, loan_status: str | None
154: ) -> dict[str, bool]:
155:     """Derive the five edge flags from metrics, history, and loan status.
156: 
157:     * pensioner: pension money in summed over all rows is above zero
158:     * thin_history: fewer than 18 monthly rows (a quarter of the 72
159:       month dataset span; the B window itself still averages min(6, n)
160:       rows regardless of this flag)
161:     * zero_income: median income I is exactly zero
162:     * defaulted_loan: the account has a loan with status D
163:     * negative_buffer: buffer B is below zero
164:     """
165:     return {
166:         "pensioner": metric.pension_in_cents > 0,
167:         "thin_history": row_count < THIN_HISTORY_ROWS,
168:         "zero_income": metric.income_cents == 0,
169:         "defaulted_loan": loan_status is not None and loan_status == DEFAULTED_STATUS,
170:         "negative_buffer": metric.buffer_cents < 0,
171:     }
172: 
173: 
174: def loan_payment_cents(monthly_payment_cents: int, status: str) -> int:
175:     """P: the loan payment when the loan runs at the end of 2025, else 0."""
176:     if status in RUNNING_STATUS_RULE:
177:         return monthly_payment_cents
178:     return 0

120:         raise ValueError("profile_metrics requires at least one row")
121:     ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row.month)
122: 
123:     income = median_cents([row.money_in for row in ordered])
124:     spending = median_cents([row.money_out for row in ordered])
125:     fixed = median_cents(
126:         [
127:             row.household_bills + row.insurance + row.loan_payments
128:             for row in ordered
129:         ]
130:     )
131:     household = median_cents([row.household_bills for row in ordered])
132:     insurance = median_cents([row.insurance for row in ordered])
133:     loan_payments = median_cents([row.loan_payments for row in ordered])
134:     pension_total = sum(row.pension_in for row in ordered)
135:     window = ordered[-min(BUFFER_WINDOW_ROWS, len(ordered)):]
136:     buffer_cents = mean_cents([row.avg_daily_balance for row in window])
137:     gap = spending - income
138: 
139:     return Metrics(
140:         income_cents=income,
141:         fixed_costs_cents=fixed,
142:         spending_cents=spending,
143:         buffer_cents=buffer_cents,
144:         household_bills_cents=household,
145:         insurance_cents=insurance,
146:         loan_payments_median_cents=loan_payments,
147:         pension_in_cents=pension_total,
148:         gap_cents=gap,
149:     )
150: 
151: 
152: def derive_flags(
153:     metric: Metrics, row_count: int, loan_status: str | None
154: ) -> dict[str, bool]:
155:     """Derive the five edge flags from metrics, history, and loan status.
156: 
157:     * pensioner: pension money in summed over all rows is above zero
158:     * thin_history: fewer than 18 monthly rows (a quarter of the 72
159:       month dataset span; the B window itself still averages min(6, n)
160:       rows regardless of this flag)
161:     * zero_income: median income I is exactly zero
162:     * defaulted_loan: the account has a loan with status D
163:     * negative_buffer: buffer B is below zero
164:     """
165:     return {
166:         "pensioner": metric.pension_in_cents > 0,
167:         "thin_history": row_count < THIN_HISTORY_ROWS,
168:         "zero_income": metric.income_cents == 0,
169:         "defaulted_loan": loan_status is not None and loan_status == DEFAULTED_STATUS,
170:         "negative_buffer": metric.buffer_cents < 0,
171:     }
172: 
173: 
174: def loan_payment_cents(monthly_payment_cents: int, status: str) -> int:
175:     """P: the loan payment when the loan runs at the end of 2025, else 0."""
176:     if status in RUNNING_STATUS_RULE:
177:         return monthly_payment_cents
178:     return 0

```ts
export function roundHalfUp(numerator: number, denominator: number): number {
  if (denominator <= 0) throw new Error(...)
  const sign = numerator >= 0 ? 1 : -1
  const magnitude = (Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator / 2)) // Python: denominator // 2
  ...

Careful: Python `(abs(numerator) + denominator // 2) // denominator`. For positive integers in JS, Math.floor division: use `Math.floor((Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator/2)) / denominator)`. /**
 * The judge shock math as pure integer functions: TypeScript twins of
 * scripts/engine/shocks.py (runway) and scripts/engine/metrics.py

export type RunwayState = 'finite' | 'no_shortfall' | 'buffer_depleted'

export const RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS = 1200

export interface RunwayAnswer {
  state: RunwayState
  deciMonths: number
}

export function roundHalfUp(numerator: number, denominator: number): number {
  if (denominator <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`roundHalfUp denominator must be positive, got ${denominator}`)
  }
  const sign = numerator >= 0 ? 1 : -1
  const magnitude = Math.floor((Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator / 2)) / denominator)
  return sign * magnitude
}
```

export function runway(bufferCents, oneOffCents, incomeCents, spendingCents): RunwayAnswer {
  const bufferLeft = bufferCents - oneOffCents
  const gap = spending_cents - income_cents
  if (bufferLeft <= 0) return { state: 'buffer_depleted', deciMonths: 0 }
  if (gap <= 0) return { state: 'no_shortfall', deciMonths: RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS }
  const deci = Math.floor((20 * bufferLeft + gap) / (2 * gap))
  return { state: 'finite', deciMonths: Math.min(deci, RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS) }
}

/**
 * The judge shock math as pure integer functions: TypeScript twins of
 * scripts/engine/shocks.py (runway) and scripts/engine/metrics.py

export type RunwayState = 'finite' | 'no_shortfall' | 'buffer_depleted'

export const RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS = 1200

export interface RunwayAnswer {
  state: RunwayState
  deciMonths: number
}

export function roundHalfUp(numerator: number, denominator: number): number {
  if (denominator <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`roundHalfUp denominator must be positive, got ${denominator}`)
  }
  const sign = numerator >= 0 ? 1 : -1
  const magnitude = Math.floor((Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator / 2)) / denominator)
  return sign * magnitude
}
```

```ts
export function runway(bufferCents, oneOffCents, incomeCents, spendingCents): RunwayAnswer {
  const bufferLeft = bufferCents - oneOffCents
  const gap = spending_cents - income_cents
  if (bufferLeft <= 0) return { state: 'buffer_depleted', deciMonths: 0 }
  if (gap <= 0) return { state: 'no_shortfall', deciMonths: RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS }
  const deci = Math.floor((20 * bufferLeft + gap) / (2 * gap))
  return { state: 'finite', deciMonths: Math.min(deci, RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS) }
}

export type RunwayState = 'finite' | 'no_shortfall' | 'buffer_depleted'

  state: RunwayState
  deciMonths: number

export function roundHalfUp(numerator: number, denominator: number): number {
  if (denominator <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`roundHalfUp denominator must be positive, got ${denominator}`)
  }
  const sign = numerator >= 0 ? 1 : -1
  const magnitude = Math.floor((Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator / 2)) / denominator)
  return sign * magnitude
}

export function runway(bufferCents, oneOffCents, incomeCents, spendingCents): RunwayAnswer {
  const bufferLeft = bufferCents - oneOffCents
  const gap = spending_cents - income_cents
  if (bufferLeft <= 0) return { state: 'buffer_depleted', deciMonths: 0 }
  if (gap <= 0) return { state: 'no_shortfall', deciMonths: RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS }
  const deci = Math.floor((20 * bufferLeft + gap) / (2 * gap))
  return { state: 'finite', deciMonths: Math.min(deci, RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS) }
}

export type RunwayState = 'finite' | 'no_shortfall' | 'buffer_depleted'

export const RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS = 1200

export interface RunwayAnswer {
  state: RunwayState
  deciMonths: number
}

export function roundHalfUp(numerator: number, denominator: number): number {
  if (denominator <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`roundHalfUp denominator must be positive, got ${denominator}`)
  }
  const sign = numerator >= 0 ? 1 : -1
  const magnitude = Math.floor((Math.abs(numerator) + Math.floor(denominator / 2)) / denominator)
  return sign * magnitude
}
```

```ts
export function runway(bufferCents, oneOffCents, incomeCents, spendingCents): RunwayAnswer {
  const bufferLeft = bufferCents - oneOffCents
  const gap = spending_cents - income_cents
  if (bufferLeft <= 0) return { state: 'buffer_depleted', deciMonths: 0 }
  if (gap <= 0) return { state: 'no_shortfall', deciMonths: RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS }
  const deci = Math.floor((20 * bufferLeft + gap) / (2 * gap))
  return { state: 'finite', deciMonths: Math.min(deci, RUNWAY_CAP_DECI_MONTHS) }
}

function proseOf(text: string): { line: number; chunk: string }[] {
  const chunks: {line, chunk}[] = []
  const patterns = [/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, /\/\/[^\n]*/g, /'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*'/g, /"(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"/g, /`(?:[^`\\]|\\.)*`/g]
  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    let match: RegExpExecArray | null
    while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null) {
      let chunk = match[0]
      // Template expressions are code, not copy.
      chunk = chunk.replace(/\$\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
      const line = text.slice(0, match.index).split('\n').length
      chunks.push({ line, chunk })
    }
  }
  // JSX text nodes: prose between tags, kept only when it reads as prose.
  const jsx = />([^<>{}]+)</g
  while ((match = jsx.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const chunk = match[1] ?? ''
    if (PROSE.test(chunk) && /[A-Za-z]/.test(chunk)) chunks.push({line, chunk})
  }
  return chunks
}

All verification is complete. Here is my report.

## Frontend Implementation: Phase E2 Console Base

### Design Plan

- **Palette (cp tokens extend rp, no second palette):** `#070c18` void ground (rp-void), `#e9effa` paper ink (rp-paper), `#ff6a4d` critical (rp-stamp), `#f4b740` storm/ledger amber (rp-money), `#8b7cf6` watch (planar, already in config), `#39c2e0` fair (signal, already in config), `#35d0ae` clear (rp-verified). One hue per verdict band, mirrored as `text-cp-*` utilities in tailwind.config.js and `--cp-band-*` custom properties in index.css.
- **Typography:** display = mono readouts (heavy, tabular numerals, negative tracking on big figures); utility = tracked uppercase mono eyebrows/labels; body = system sans for sentences. Same three rp roles, so the console and the report read as one system.
- **Layout:** one shell column (lookup) over a two column grid (5fr baseline / 7fr shock) over a full width plan row; single column under 64rem, plan blocks join at 48rem.

```
+--------------------------------------------------+
| Know the customer  [ account id ] [open account] |
+------------------------+-------------------------+
| Current conditions     | Take a shock             |
| Account 68257          | twist card sentence      |
| I F S B H P gap loan   | [layoff][bills][repair]  |
| [verdict compact]      | ======================== |
| 5 flag chips           | HERO VERDICT (glyph +    |
| recorded check sum     |  band + huge runway)     |
|                        | 4 sliders               |
|                        | now / after table        |
|                        | [reset shock]            |
+------------------------+-------------------------+
| Goal: build the cushion | Backup: if the shock lands |
+--------------------------------------------------+
```

- **Signature element:** the verdict badge. Glyph + uppercase band name + runway number at `clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 4rem)` in the band hue, always labeled "steady state", `role="status"` for announcements, and a `cp-tick` animation re-triggered by a `key` on the band and tenths (killed by the existing reduced motion rule). From 2 m a judge reads glyph, color, and the number; the label and threshold carry the same information in text, so color is never the only channel.

### Components Modified

| File | Component | Purpose |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `src/data/profiles.ts` | loader | Types, strict `parseProfilesArtifact` (named errors), `loadProfiles`, `loadSharedProfiles` (memo clears on failure), `searchAccountIds` |
| `src/data/profiles.test.ts` | tests | 12 refusal cases, shipped artifact parse, baseline cross-check over all 4,500 profiles, search ranking |
| `src/lib/shocks.ts` | math | `roundHalfUp`, `scaleCents`, `runway` (exact Python twin), `Twist`, `IDLE_TWIST`, `normalizeTwist`, `sameTwist`, `applyTwist`, slider unit helpers |
| `src/lib/metrics.ts` | math (added) | `medianCents`, `meanCents` twins for the golden fixture check |
| `src/lib/shockPresets.ts` | presets | 4 judge cards with typed twists |
| `src/lib/verdict.ts` | bands | 5 confirmed bands, `verdictBand()` |
| `src/lib/planText.ts` | plan | goal + backup sentences, no lever machinery |
| `src/lib/format.ts` | format | `formatDeciMonths`, non-finite guard, negative cents documented |
| `src/state/consoleStore.ts` | store | Zustand 5, idempotent `boot`, selection validation, preset match on every twist change, both resets, E6 key reservation comment, no listeners |
| `src/components/console/ConsoleView.tsx` | shell | boot flow, `useMemo` derivation (applyTwist to verdictBand to buildPlanText), empty and error states |
| `.../AccountLookup.tsx` | lookup | `id="account-lookup"`, prefix then substring suggestions, example-id copy in both empty states |
